stats.title: 6 Old Money Wardrobe Essentials You Need This Fall

structure.what_is_said: "Fall is here, and today I'm sharing five old money wardrobe staples that will instantly make your fall looks more sophisticated, elegant,"
how_it_is_shown: "Fall is Here" script over a creator close-up, then 3 more creator clips (jump-cut stutter at 3.7)

structure.what_is_said: "and expensive. You can find everything mentioned today at the links below. Let's" - title "Classy Academy Lookbook / 6 Old Money Fall Essentials / Episode 01" on dark brown with 4 dimmed lookbook panels
"start with the" - text "SHOP THE LOOKS ⬇ / Mentioned pieces linked below" (the links mention itself is spoken at 12-13)
"classics. First, a nice knitted sweater." over "1. Sweaters"
Cable knit adds texture; cotton or cashmere is softer; timeless colours cream, oatmeal, navy, chocolate; loose not baggy; pair with tailored trousers or jeans.
how_it_is_shown: rows on taupe/dark brown, labelled lookbook, detail close-up, centred clips

structure.what_is_said: "Next-up. For a simple fall capsule wardrobe, you really only" over "2. Bottoms"
Three things: structured pants (cream, chocolate, camel, graphite, black; Aritzia), great jeans in darker shades (Abercrombie), something softer - satin/silk or cotton trousers with ties.
how_it_is_shown: centred clip swaps, product line-up, labelled lookbook + details, "Elevated" accent card

structure.what_is_said: "Next up- your fall outerwear. Think" over "3. Outerwear"
Cardigans, button-down jackets, a suede jacket; throw one on to elevate a simple look; "they will become your best friends this fall".
how_it_is_shown: centred clip swaps, labelled lookbook with an older model, detail close-up

structure.what_is_said: Must-have; black or deep brown (Dolce Vita); low heel for long walks; wear with skinny jeans, leggings, midi skirts or loose trousers; "your feet will thank me".
how_it_is_shown: rows, labelled lookbook + boot close-up, centred clip swaps

structure.what_is_said: "Next up-a structured bag." over "5. Structured Bags"
Makes a simple look neater; clear shapes, minimal accessories, deep autumn colours; DeMellier London; cheaper JW Pei and Amazon.
how_it_is_shown: centred photo growing from the bottom, rows, labelled bag close-ups
157.1-161.1 DARK BROWN + centred photo (grow from bottom)

structure.what_is_said: "a great fall coat. Choose" over "6. Fall Coat"
Neutral shades, quality fabrics (wool, wool blends, thick cotton); belted coat shapes the waist; easiest way to look elegant and stay warm.
how_it_is_shown: labelled lookbook + detail, row on taupe, centred clips

structure.what_is_said: "warm throughout the fall. That's all for today."
"If you want a second part or another video in lookbook format, write about it in the comments. You can find everything that was presented today"
how_it_is_shown: car clip, Breakfast at Tiffany's scene; no text

structure.what_is_said: "at the links below. Don't forget to like, subscribe, and chat with me in the comments. I always enjoy reading your reviews. Our complete guide to elegant style is also available at the link below. Until the next meeting. Goodbye, my dears."
how_it_is_shown: three full clips, dip to black, dissolve to brown; no on-screen text

tricks: Q1 HOOK (0-8.2): the first frame already carries the hook text "Fall is Here" (white script, 0-1.2); then 4 creator outfit clips in 8 s (1.2, 3.7, 4.8) - one clip is chopped into 0.2 s jump cuts (3.7-4.8) for energy. The title arrives at 8.5 as a separate dark-brown card "Classy Academy Lookbook / 6 Old Money Fall Essentials / Episode 01" with 4 lookbook models building behind it on "elegant, and expensive".
Q1: the voice says "five old money wardrobe staples" but the title and the cards count 6 (1. Sweaters ... 6. Fall Coat) - a mismatch left in.

Q2 POINT OPENING: each point card is a white script "N. Category" written over a full lookbook doorway clip (not a white card): 16.8 Sweaters, 52.5 Bottoms (after a dip to black), 97.3 Outerwear, 120.9 Boots, 153.3 Structured Bags, 192.6 Fall Coat. The voice READS the category every time ("First, a nice knitted sweater", "Next up- knee-high boots", "Next up-a structured bag", "And finally, a great fall coat"). Card held 2.3-4.3 s. Points close on a row or centred clip, then a cut to the next card.

Q3 CLIP LENGTHS: labelled lookbook clips 2.5-5.8 s; detail close-ups 1.9-3.5 s (always right after the labelled full shot, joined by a 1.8-2.7 s dissolve: 30.5, 88.8, 94.5, 116.2); centred creator clips 1.2-5 s, often 2-3 swaps inside the same frame on the same background; rows hold 4-7 s. Longest single shots: car woman 215.3-223.0 (7.7 s), Selena-like walk 227.8-235.5 (7.7 s).

Q4 ROWS: 8 rows of 2-4 panels (taupe: 20.4, 123.5, 169.7, 201.1; dark brown: 8.2 title row with 4 panels, 40.9, 146.5, 161.1). All different creators, matched by outfit colour (burgundy row 40.9, knee-boot row 123.5, bag colour row 169.7). They build one panel at a time 0.4-0.8 s apart, or middle first and outer two together (20.4, 201.1). In 169.7-174.8 each panel lands on a spoken colour ("chocolate, burgundy, black, or olive").

Q4 BACKGROUND COLOURS: this video uses taupe/beige-pink (#c4ae9f-like) and dark chocolate brown (#2f2219-like) flat backgrounds, plus one cream wavy gradient (71.3-80.1) - not the caramel gradient of the evergreen videos.

Q5 SMALL TEXT: product labels in white serif bottom-right on every lookbook product shot (15 labels, listed in text_treatments). Brands are also spoken (Aritzia, Abercrombie, DeMellier London, JW Pei, Amazon) but several labels name brands never spoken (Quince, OGL, Zara, Dolce Vita). No creator credits/@handles anywhere.

Q5/Q10 LOOKBOOK SOURCE: every labelled product shot is in the SAME white-panelled doorway room (olive tree, rattan armchair, herringbone floor) with different models (light, olive, dark skin; ages ~25 to ~60) and slight motion only - judged possibly AI-generated. Real creator reels fill the rows and centred frames.

Q6 NAMED WOMEN: only at the end - Audrey Hepburn in Breakfast at Tiffany's (223.0-227.8, full screen film, 4.8 s) and a Selena-Gomez-like woman (227.8-235.5, full screen, unclear). None inside the points.
Q7 DO/DON'T: none. Colour lists are shown literally: trousers pop in one per spoken colour (61.0-66.4), bags one per colour (169.7-174.8).

Q8 GUIDE/LINKS: links are spoken at 12-13 under the title; then a "SHOP THE LOOKS ⬇ / Mentioned pieces linked below" card 14.4-16.8. Comment ask 219.0-227.8 ("If you want a second part or another video in lookbook format, write about it in the comments") over a car clip and Breakfast at Tiffany's - no text. Outro 227.8-245.0: like/subscribe/comment + "Our complete guide to elegant style is also available at the link below" - no guide graphic, no subscribe graphic.

Q9 ENDING: last 30 s: car woman (to 223.0), Breakfast at Tiffany's (223.0-227.8), houndstooth walk (227.8-235.5), dip to black, cafe woman (236.5-240.5), black-coat creator (240.5-243.7), dissolve to dark brown, white CA logo end card 245.0-254.9 (~10 s, much shorter than the 30 s card of mFLqPSyb4eQ). Music sting ~245.5-250 (~-28 dB) then fade to silence ~251.5.

Q10 TRANSITIONS: hard cuts dominate; dissolves 1.8-2.7 s only into detail close-ups and between bag shots; one dip to black before point 2 (52.3) and one before the cafe clip (235.8); centred photo "grows up from the bottom edge" once (157.4-158.2); centred clip slides into place once (19.3-20.0); product label and point text write/fade on.

Q10 PICTURE vs WORDS: very literal - the exact item named is on screen with its label; colours named = colours shown; "a model with a belt" = a belted coat (205.2); "low heel" = boot close-up (131.1).
